summary: Cybin Inc., operating commercially as Helus Pharma, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 21, 2026 news release announcing CEO Michael Halstead's participation in a fireside chat at the TD Cowen 6th Annual Novel Mechanisms in Neuropsychiatry Summit on September 23, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. EDT. The filing is a routine investor-conference announcement, not a special situation. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Watch for any subsequent 6-K disclosing material corporate action, but this item alone carries no risk-arb angle.
